message:
I remember the time we had that big snowstorm, the kind that makes you question your life choices about living in the Midwest. I had just settled in with a hot cup of tea, ready to binge-watch my favorite show, when my phone decided it was the perfect moment to die. No power, no Netflix, no way to check the weather updates! 

I learned that day the importance of having a good old-fashioned battery-powered radio and some extra candles on hand—who knew they weren’t just for birthday cakes? So, if you’re ever caught in a storm and your tech decides to abandon you, at least you can still enjoy the sound of the wind while sipping tea by candlelight. 

What’s your go-to tip for staying prepared when the unexpected happens?
